name: tuwen-forge
description: Turns content, a story, or a bare topic into publish-ready Chinese image-text cards by typesetting code, not by generating images. Chooses the output (single card, full carousel, WeChat cover pair, or long infographic), routes across a professional CJK typesetting / storytelling / imagery knowledge base, composes single-file HTML/CSS, renders deterministically to PNG via Playwright, and passes a mechanical layout gate before delivery.

displayDescription.en: Typesets content into publish-ready Chinese cards with code: single card, full carousel, WeChat cover pair or long infographic — style auto-matched or chosen by you.
displayDescription.zh: 用代码把内容精确排成可直接发布的中文图文：单图、整套轮播、公众号封面与长图，风格自动匹配。
